repeat_control_seed_rule: same original policy seed and advance as continue_a
root_observation_rule: same fixed lossless root bytes for all five methods; verified original if present, otherwise a single pre-action measurement documented as new reference
post_root_observations: live, all actual policy inputs saved losslessly; no historical future-input forcing
robust_rescue_rule: original baseline fail AND continue_a fail AND continue_b fail AND any fixed candidate success, unique episode count

analysis.units: 269 paired roots nested in 200 episodes and 10 tasks; early/late cohorts reported separately
metrics: paired successes and losses vs continue
additional policy calls and inference seconds
analysis.intervals: Exploratory task-cluster bootstrap; no multiplicity-adjusted or confirmation claim. Roots and branches are not independent episodes.
analysis.oracle: Any-candidate success is only an offline feasibility upper bound, never a deployed selector score.
analysis.feasibility_gate: If at least 8 distinct baseline-failure episodes have a successful alternative and every continue control passes, proceed to frozen-encoder progress/value module development with fixed fit/calibration split. Otherwise improve the recovery candidates/teacher before training a selector; no outcome-driven repeated branch sampling.
analysis.noise_limit: One fixed stochastic stream per method/root; labels are sampled outcomes, not exact conditional expected values.

approval_required_because: Changes exact historic closed-loop trajectory acceptance to recorded-input/model and action/physics reconstruction with a fixed contemporary paired control. Existing unconsumed-image approvals do not cover actual inference inputs.

resources.remaining_budget_freeze: subtract finished parent attempts and probes before launch

prelaunch_requirements: finish and clean current strict queue
freeze complete sources, input identities and remaining resource budget
register same originating thread and terminal completion/failure trigger
